what: When the distance between the cursor and a letter’s center is within 400px, the weight blends from the resting weight toward the near weight by 1 − distance/400, and each letter follows over 0.4s power2.out — only the letters near the cursor get thinner or bolder

options.rest: Weight when resting, default is the element’s font-weight
options.near: Thickness when the cursor is directly above, default rest
options.[data-fx-part=alt] data-rest · data-near: Weight pairs for inner words only (a thin serif word inside a bold heading, 300→800, etc.)
options.curve: If smooth, the strength uses smoothstep (fills faster toward the center), default is linear (1 − distance/radius)
options.follow: If set, instead of the dur tween it follows this fraction of the remaining difference each frame (0.01~1) — Blog .13
options.axes: Variable axes that change together with weight at the same intensity "Tags for resting and close states"with commas — "opsz 12 144, SOFT 0 40"(Fraunces). Other axes (WONK etc.) stay as the element’s font-variation-settings
options.reach: Reach distance as a multiple of element width (used instead of radius if given) — one menu uses .9. With short menu words, a px radius reaches into the neighboring menu.
options.steps: If given, it counts by ”how many letters from the letter nearest the cursor” instead of distance — those letters’ shares ("1 .7 .4 .15" …if so, the center is 100% and the sides 70·40·15%), and the rest return to their resting weight. Reacts only over the element (microdose 400→600)
options.out: Return duration from steps (seconds), default dur — microdose .4 (entry dur .2)
options.trusted: If true, it listens only to a real human pointer — so letters don’t react on their own when the page fires a demo fake cursor (dispatchEvent pointermove). Default false

use: Your big title here Moving Text

from.where: Menu section name (.mt-kin-char) — weight 500→690 by smoothstep strength within a 160px radius, pulled toward the cursor by font size × .16 (.35s lens)
from.note: In the original the distance curve is smoothstep (k²(3−2k)) and letters are pulled toward the cursor — this part uses linear distance with no pull, so within the site it is built separately as kinetic in shared.js

note: It is only visible with a variable font that has a wght axis. The cursor’s page position is recorded only while it moves, so when you only scroll that position stays as it was (same as the original). Not applied on touch or reduced motion. The original attaches after all letters have risen (reveal:done) — when used together with text reveal, add data-fx after the reveal
